'PAMBIHIRA ANG PAG-ULAN'

READ: The Quezon City government said it recorded "phenomenal" rainfall on Saturday, Aug. 30, which caused severe flooding in several areas.

The city government said it logged 121 millimeters of rainfall within one hour, higher than the around 90 mm per hour during the devastating Typhoon Ondoy in 2009.

"Hindi kinaya ng drainage system ng lungsod ang napakaraming tubig-ulan sa napakaikling oras kaya nagresulta ito ng malalang pagbaha, maging sa ilang lugar na hindi karaniwang binabaha," it said.

The local government said it is addressing the drainage system issues through its drainage master plan.

📸 Quezon City Government/Facebook

Para sa emergency, tumawag sa QC HELPLINE 122.

❗️🇦🇺 - Hundreds of Australian citizens participated in an anti-immigration rally in Canberra, voicing concerns over immigration policies. 

Protesters, waving Australian and Eureka flags, highlighted issues such as strained public services, housing shortages, and cultural integration challenges attributed to immigration. 

The majority of recent immigrants to Australia originate from India, China, and the Philippines, with significant numbers also from the Middle East and Africa, according to government data.

A smaller counter-rally supporting immigration was held nearby, with police ensuring separation between the groups to maintain order.
